summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the two iteration_29 fixes on WebAdminDashboard.tsx at 1440x900. Both flagged issues are FIXED. (1) OFFER HISTORY now reads the correct backend price_history schema (new_price, previous_price, comment, new_notes, at, admin_name). Verified on FB-000105 (1 entry, previous_price=null) -> 'R 200 000 / Initial offer / 2026/07/22, 10:01:28 / Fourbuy Admin' with no dashes; and on FB-000090 (3 entries with was-branches) -> 'R 60 000 / Initial offer', 'R 65 000  was R 60 000 / Price updated', 'R 70 000  was R 65 000 / Price updated', each with timestamp and admin_name on the right column. (2) VIN-LINKED REPORTS row title now uses r.name first: 'Lightstone Vehicle Verification Report' and 'Lightstone Vehicle Repair History Report' render correctly (lightstone_verification / lightstone_repair slugs no longer leak). A third report on FB-000090 (type=carvertical) renders 'Car Vertical Report' from the backend r.name value. Section ordering (MARKET VALUES -> VIN-LINKED REPORTS -> LICENSE DISK DATA -> OFFER HISTORY) is preserved. Regression pass: MARKET VALUES tile (LOCKED AT VALUATION pill + all four values) and LICENSE DISK DATA render on both subs; ACCIDENT/CLAIM HISTORY intentionally not re-exercised (no seeded kredo_vin_history.status=ok sub per iteration_29 note). Dealers, Billing, Rewards, Kredo tabs all functional; INCOMING(0)/PRICED(9)/ARCHIVED(1) buckets filter correctly.
